source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

parts.target: A **GENESTEALER CULTS BATTLELINE** unit of yours that is in [Cult Ambush](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.cult-ambush).
parts.effect: Whenever you set the unit up with a [Cult Ambush](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.cult-ambush) marker during the rest of the phase, place it at a spot that is wholly within 6" of the marker used and not in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy unit.

data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase).

**Target:** A **GENESTEALER CULTS BATTLELINE** unit of yours that is in [Cult Ambush](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.cult-ambush).

**Effect:** Whenever you set the unit up with a [Cult Ambush](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.cult-ambush) marker during the rest of the phase, place it at a spot that is wholly within 6" of the marker used and not in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy unit.
